ai.seo_question: What is the primary purpose of the Quran according to Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Quran's dual role as a spiritual reminder (dhikr) and a practical guide for all realms of existence, reflecting the Imams' view of the text as a living source of wisdom. It connects the divine message to the concept of *tadhkirah*, emphasizing that its universal scope encompasses both the physical world and the spiritual realm, inviting all beings to reflect on their creation and purpose.
